construction.implementation_origin: Original implementation authored in the isolated build directory

shared_schema.input: Strict JSON object: schema_version, synthetic=true, as_of ISO date, customers[], transaction_ledger{format:json|csv,data}, loans[], payments[], documents[]. JSON ledger data is a list; CSV data is an inline string.
shared_schema.customer: id, name, account FAKE-IBAN-prefixed, kyc_status complete|pending|rejected, screening{sanctions:boolean,pep:boolean}
shared_schema.transaction: id, customer_id, amount positive decimal, currency three uppercase letters, date, card_number digit string
shared_schema.loan: id, customer_id, amount, currency, monthly_income, monthly_payment; income and payment assumed in loan currency
shared_schema.document: id, entity_type customer|transaction|loan, entity_id, kind, verified boolean, issued_on, expires_on ISO date or null
shared_schema.output: schema_version, status, synthetic, as_of, stage, notice, results[], gaps[]. Results contain entity references, evidence checks, screening flags, explainable risk_score, disposition and masked transaction card numbers.
shared_schema.validation: Shared validate() gate normalizes CSV/JSON and validates references, uniqueness, dates, financial amounts, booleans, synthetic account markers and payment consistency. Strict CLI JSON parsing rejects duplicate fields and nonfinite numbers. Errors return a non-echoing JSON error object and exit 2.

cross_stage_handoffs: Single document-review stage only: validated normalized entity maps and document index feed deterministic evidence checks; checks feed traceable gaps and explained review-priority scores.

behavior.evidence: Customer identity/address/AML review, transaction payment authorization, loan income/affordability. At least one verified document issued on or before as_of and not expired satisfies each requirement. Expiry on as_of is accepted. Rejected evidence retains explicit reasons.
behavior.screening: Incomplete KYC +20, sanctions flag +40, PEP flag +15 inherited by linked transactions and loans; transaction amount >=10000 currency units +15; missing payment payload +10; zero income or loan payment >40% income +25.
behavior.explainability: Each evidence gap +10. Score=min(100,sum(contribution.points)), baseline 0, all contributions include rule and basis. Scores are demonstrative review priorities, not approval predictions.
behavior.masking: Output shows only final four PAN digits; CLI error messages never echo input. Demonstrates PCI DSS-style masking, not PCI DSS certification.
behavior.fixtures: Clearly labeled fabricated customer, fake accounts and zero-prefixed fake PANs. Tests generate 25 reproducible randomized synthetic transactions with random.Random(134). No live data.
behavior.determinism: Explicit as_of date, deterministic ordering, no clock-based decisions and no LLM dependency.

included: JSON and inline CSV transaction ledgers
excluded: Actual identity verification or sanctions screening
Production persistence, access control or enterprise operation
